title: (Pwn2Own) Linux Kernel io_uring Improper Update of Reference Count Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Linux Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the io_uring API. The issue results from the improper management of a reference count. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
